title: Google Ads for Window Companies | Built-Right Digital

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital's Google Ads management for window and door companies is a flat $999/month, with ad spend paid to Google directly.
facts.quote: Our [Google Ads management](https://builtrightdigital.com/google-ads/) for window and door companies is a flat $999/month, and you pay ad spend to Google directly.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital reports a 4.9/5 star rating across major review sites.
Built-Right Digital states it has served 450+ clients.
Built-Right Digital states its average client tenure is 5+ years.
Built-Right Digital states it has been in business for 10+ years.
Built-Right Digital states that its campaigns are built around specific replacement services so the budget stays on profitable jobs instead of generic inquiries.
facts.quote: We build your campaigns from the ground up around specific replacement services. That keeps your budget on profitable jobs instead of generic inquiries.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital states that it tracks every phone call and form submission back to the original click.
facts.quote: We track every phone call and form submission directly back to the original click.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital states that its clients own their ad accounts completely and maintain full access to all historical data.
facts.quote: You own your ad accounts completely and you maintain full access to all historical data.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital's Local Services Ads management is priced at $299 per month.
Built-Right Digital's Google Ads management is a flat $999 per month, with ad spend paid to Google directly.
facts.quote: Google Ads management at Built-Right Digital is a flat $999/month, and you pay ad spend to Google directly

facts.fact: Across Built-Right Digital's home services clients, the average cost per lead is under $30 (vendor's own claim), though high-ticket window jobs can run higher.
facts.quote: Across our home services clients, the average cost per lead is under $30, though high-ticket window jobs can run higher.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital says it updates its window and door negative keyword list every week.
facts.quote: We update the list every week to refine your incoming traffic.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital says it monitors client accounts daily to adjust keyword bids and pause underperforming ads.
facts.quote: Our team monitors your account daily to adjust keyword bids and systematically pause underperforming ads.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital says paid search can start generating qualified phone calls and form fills within the first few days after launch, while automated bidding needs a few weeks of data to optimize.
facts.quote: the algorithm requires a few weeks of consistent data to fully optimize all automated bidding strategies.

facts.fact: Built-Right Digital's window and door negative keyword lists are set up before campaigns launch and block cheap wholesale materials and DIY repair tutorial searches.
facts.quote: We set up negative keyword lists built for window and door companies before your campaigns launch.
